physicalBalanced.downsampling: 2x2 nearest categorical (bottom-right tie); never average packed class codes

riversBalanced.downsampling: 2x2 maximum pooling before native WTR center mask; 255 modern takes precedence over 128 native

riversDistance.coastline: Renderer clips every fragment against native WTR after distance expansion
riversDistance.distanceEncoding: (value - 128) / 16 texture texels; positive inside; clamped signed Euclidean boundary distance
riversDistance.provenance: Original 128/255 source values retained in source mask; uniform opacity in distance rendering
riversDistance.widthControl: Relative edge adjustment: (width - 1) / 2 texture texels per side; not CSS pixels or a proportional width multiplier

riversDistanceBalanced.distanceEncoding: (value - 128) / 16 texture texels; positive inside; clamped signed Euclidean boundary distance
riversDistanceBalanced.provenance: Original 128/255 source values retained in source mask; uniform opacity in distance rendering
riversDistanceBalanced.widthControl: Relative edge adjustment: (width - 1) / 2 texture texels per side; not CSS pixels or a proportional width multiplier

coverage.sampleMethod: native-aligned 10-pixel center grid, WTR excluded for land fraction
coverage.unsupported: Reference: farther than 500 native px from city controls or failed inverse. Broad illumination: outside lon +/-180, lat [-60,85], failed inverse or fold. Polar and remote domains remain approximate or unsupported.

hillshade.reason: Native heightmap has only two values; no trustworthy registered DEM in this build.

labelNames.policy: ID/original bilingual value-bound corrections; uncertain Chinese falls back to English. Pinned OpenCC 1.1.9 longest phrase then character, first target.

nativeCrosscheck.interpretation: Native terrain index 14/15 water vs native WTR; this does not validate modern land-cover categories.

physicalInterpretation: Native terrain base plus optional modern physical reference classification in separate nibbles; native WTR mask; classes retain separate sources.

qualityLevels.categoricalSampling: Terrain requires NEAREST GPU sampling; interpolation of packed high/low class nibbles invents categories.
qualityLevels.coastline: Downsampled cells are masked at their native WTR center. Renderer must additionally clip terrain/river effects per original native WTR fragment to prevent coarse cells extending into adjacent water.
qualityLevels.projection: Geographic registration and reprojection are baked offline into both quality levels; sampling uses the native HGO plane.
qualityLevels.textureEdges: Whole-map textures use CLAMP_TO_EDGE; no tiles or stitching gutters/padding are required.

rivers.interpretation: Modern river centerlines plus native mod linework; lake centerlines omitted; native WTR clipped; native supplement is not modern hydrographic validation.

temporalPolicy: Modern physical reference, not a measured 1936 surface or a game simulation.
